title: Which points, line, rays and segments are in the figure?
description: A figure has a line through D, E, O and B, with a ray from O through C and another ray going straight up from O. The marked points are collected first, then the line, the rays and the segments are named from them. A last check counts the names against the question.
teaching_notes: One idea: points, a line, rays and segments are all named from the marked letters, and a ray name always begins at its starting point. Watch for students who name a ray with the wrong letter first.

source: In the figure, name: Five points, A line, Four rays, Five line segments.
video_script.why: The child names the parts of one figure by reading the marked letters, with a ray named from its starting point and a segment from its two end points.
video_script.substitution: Read the letters on the figure one by one and group them by the kind of part.
video_script.anchor: a figure with a line through the points D, E, O and B, a ray from O through C, and another ray going straight up from O
video_script.payoff_line: All four parts are named from the figure

final_answer.value: a) D, E, O, B, C. b) line DB. c) rays OC, OB, OE, OD. d) segments DE, DO, DB, EO, EB
final_answer.spoken: the five points are D, E, O, B and C. The line is D B. The rays are O C, O B, O E and O D. The segments are D E, D O, D B, E O and E B

never_show: the full list of names for all four parts, before the answer beat
maths_rules: The marked letters on the figure are D, E, O, B and C, so there are five points.
Any two points on the line, such as D and B, name the line, so it is line DB.
Every ray in the figure starts at O, so each ray name begins with O: OC, OB, OE and OD.
A segment lies between two marked points on the line, so DE, DO, DB, EO and EB are five segments.
Check: each ray name starts with O, and each segment name has two end points.
video_script.design: One idea: read the letters, then group them by the kind of part. The figure stays on the board and each group lights up in its own colour. The method is the same way as the example in the book on the ray.
open_questions: The figure is not visible in the extracted text. If E lies between D and O, then the rays OE and OD are the same ray, and the line has six segments including OB, so the worklist answer of four rays and five segments needs a check against the printed figure. The video follows the worklist answer.
